mcqs.question: Which project was launched in Rayalaseema on 22 May 2026 as the first project under the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024?
options: SAEL Industries’ 600 MW solar project involving an investment of ₹3,000 crore
Gandikota-II 2,250 MW pumped-storage project involving an investment of ₹3,000 crore
SAEL Industries’ 2,250 MW solar project involving an investment of ₹10 lakh crore
Solar ingot-wafer manufacturing project at Anakapalli involving an investment of ₹2,250 crore
mcqs.explanation: SAEL Industries’ 600 MW solar project, involving ₹3,000 crore, was launched in Rayalaseema on 22 May 2026 as the first project under the policy. Gandikota-II is a separate pumped-storage project of 2,250 MW in YSR Kadapa.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh’s Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024 and its clean-energy targets, consider the following statements:

1. The policy covers projects such as pumped storage and solar ingot-wafer manufacturing at Anakapalli.
2. The 2,250 MW Gandikota-II pumped-storage project in YSR Kadapa was allotted to Adani Hydro Energy Eleven Ltd.
3. Andhra Pradesh aims for about ₹10 lakh crore investment and more than 150 GW of renewable-energy capacity.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
options: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The stated renewable-energy capacity target is 160 GW+, not more than 150 GW; therefore, statement 3 is incorrect.

mcqs.question: Who announced the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed at SRM University-AP, and on which occasion?
options: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on World Telecommunication and Information Society Day, 17 May
Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on National Technology Day, 11 May
Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on 14 April 2026
Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on 22 May 2026
mcqs.explanation: The test bed was announced by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on World Telecommunication and Information Society Day, observed on 17 May. National Technology Day is associated with the deep-tech skilling announcement.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed focuses on quantum communication hardware, photonic and optical systems, encryption and cyber defence.
Reason (R): Quantum Key Distribution enables secure key sharing in which interception can be detected.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and the reason are true. However, the QKD feature of detectable interception does not by itself explain the entire range of systems covered by the test bed, so the reason is not the correct explanation of the assertion.

mcqs.question: Which facility had been launched earlier, on 14 April 2026, in the context of Andhra Pradesh’s quantum-technology initiatives?
options: Quantum Computing Reference Facilities
Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed
NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre
DRDO–NSTL R&D centre
mcqs.explanation: Quantum Computing Reference Facilities were launched earlier on 14 April 2026. The Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed was announced on 17 May.

mcqs.question: The DRDO–NSTL R&D centre in Amaravati Quantum Valley, established at a cost of ₹22.50 crore, is intended to work on which area?
options: Quantum computational fluid dynamics and hybrid classical–quantum workflows
Quantum communication hardware and photonic or optical systems only
Solar ingot-wafer manufacturing and pumped storage
Quantum computing, AI, quantum communication and semiconductors
mcqs.explanation: The ₹22.50 crore NSTL centre will focus on quantum computational fluid dynamics and hybrid classical–quantum workflows. Quantum communication hardware and photonic systems are associated with the separate Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed.

mcqs.question: Where will the DRDO–NSTL R&D centre initially operate, and what is the size of its plug-and-play space?
options: Medha Towers, Gannavaram, in a 5,000 sq ft space
Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur, in a 5,000 sq ft space
Anakapalli, in a 2,250 MW facility
SRM University-AP, in a 22.50 crore facility
mcqs.explanation: The centre will initially start at Medha Towers, Gannavaram, using 5,000 sq ft of plug-and-play space under the AP Quantum Computing Policy. Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur, is the location of the NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the role of the Andhra Pradesh Task Force for Quantum Technologies and Biosciences?
options: It guides Amaravati Quantum Valley in relation to the National Quantum Mission 2023–2031, valued at about ₹6,003 crore
It conducts the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed launched on 17 May
It manages the 600 MW solar project launched in Rayalaseema on 22 May 2026
It administers the NIELIT centre at Acharya Nagarjuna University for 2026–27
mcqs.explanation: The task force guides Amaravati Quantum Valley and is linked with the National Quantum Mission 2023–2031, valued at about ₹6,003 crore. The other options refer to separate clean-energy, communications or skilling initiatives.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement A: The Andhra Pradesh deep-tech skilling initiative was announced by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on National Technology Day, 11 May.
Statement B: National Technology Day commemorates the Pokhran tests of 1999.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct: the initiative was announced by N. Chandrababu Naidu on 11 May, National Technology Day. Statement B is incorrect because the Pokhran tests commemorated by the day took place in 1998, not 1999.

mcqs.keyword: NIELIT centre, medals and mission details
mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements are correct?

1. The NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre is located at Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur.
2. Andhra Pradesh students won 4 Gold and 14 Silver medals in NPTEL examinations.
3. The National Quantum Mission has an allocation of ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023–24 to 2030–30.
4. NIELIT functions under the Ministry of Education.
options: Only one
Only two
Only three
All four
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the National Quantum Mission period ends in 2030–31, not 2030–30; statement 4 is incorrect because NIELIT is under MeitY.
